newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka to slash holding in Ceramic.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka to slash holding in Ceramic.

text.p: The Sri Lankan government is slashing its stake in the blue chip Lanka Cermaic Ltd by selling a part of the 5.1 million shares it holds in the company, a government officials said on Tuesday.
The official of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission (PERC) told Reuters that the government was offering 2.19 million shares of the company on the exchange on Tuesday.
"The shares will be held on bid an an all-or-none basis for three days, at a minimum price of 40 rupees each," the official said.
The scrip last traded at 40 rupees on May 26.
The government currently holds 17.3 percent of the firm's issued capital of 30 million shares.
The balance will also be put up for sale shortly, the official said.
